message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Validate

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: none
  pull-requests: none

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate

    env:
      FORCE_COLOR: 1
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: 1
      NGROK_AUTHTOKEN: ${{ secrets.NGROK_AUTHTOKEN }}
      NGROK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NGROK_API_KEY }}
      NGROK_SUBDOMAIN: ${{ github.repository_owner }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Set up Python 3.13
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Build test coverage
        run: make install test
      - name: Build docs
        run: make docs
      - name: Check code
        run: make check
      - name: Validate package
        run: make local
      - name: Test downstream
        run: make test-downstream
      - name: Cleanup temporary test resources
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: make delete-temp-test-resources
      - name: Upload test coverage
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./build/coverage
      - name: Upload test results
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./build/test-results
          report_type: test_results",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Python 3.13 reusable workflow that installs dependencies with pip via `make install test` but currently has no dependency cache. The measured experiment `experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2` (pattern P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) and the literature pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE both support adding an `actions/cache@v4` step for `~/.cache/pip` keyed on `pyproject.toml` before dependency installation, preserving all install/test steps while reducing elapsed CI time. `pyproject.toml` exists in the repository, so the cache key is valid. The change is minimal, adds no new secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment operations, or network access, and preserves all existing make targets and coverage/upload steps.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
